no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Mannatech is a global wellness / nutritional supplement direct-selling company (network marketing) selling proprietary supplements (Ambrotose, Manapol, Glycentials), skin care, and weight-management products in 25 markets. The company operates in the dietary supplement industry, not the regulated pharmaceutical industry. No drug candidates, no IND, no FDA-regulated clinical trials in any phase. Per FY2025 10-K, sole reporting segment is nutritional supplements sold through network marketing channels.
